# Kartikey Tanna

> Kartikey Tanna is a software engineer who has built software for more than ten years, for startups and small companies, most of them in the US, and is CTO of Hero Group LLC. With his wife Sweta, he makes websites for small businesses, as Sweta and Kartikey.

## Websites for small businesses

- [Websites for small businesses](https://www.kartikey.dev/websites/): what Sweta and Kartikey make, how their samples work, and what happens if you say yes. Each new website is made first as a working sample the owner can see working before deciding anything, and there's nothing to pay to look.
- [Sweta and Kartikey](https://proposals.kartikey.dev/): the studio's own site, with its facts in plain text at https://proposals.kartikey.dev/llms.txt
- [Send us your website](https://proposals.kartikey.dev/start): they make a new version of it for you to try

## About

- [About Kartikey](https://www.kartikey.dev/about/): his work, mostly in Ruby on Rails: Sidecar Learning (lead backend developer from 2018, CTO from 2020 to 2024), Reword, the e-commerce platform for a high-end keyboard brand, UltraAuth, Hero Group LLC (CTO), and eKard
- [FAQ](https://www.kartikey.dev/faq/)
